---
title: "Storage and flexibility"
lang: en
---
**Excel location:** [🔋 Flexibilität und Speicher]{.excel-menu .darkred} worksheet.

Energy flexibility connects the timing of renewable energy with district operation. Local PV surplus and external flexibility signals can enable additional conditioning and storage charging. **Minimum demand coverage and flexible overcoverage** are separate quantities.

![Electricity flows: dispatch order, minimum demand and flexible storage charging. Training diagram supplied by the project owner; active paths depend on the model configuration.](../media/manual/dispatch.png){.manual-figure}

## Enabling flexibility and selecting signals {#flexibility-input}

::: {.excel-operation}
### In the Excel tool
Check PV surplus use and [Use Signal]{.excel-field} independently. Select which applications may respond to the signal and define their power limits. [Presets](presets.qmd) provide an initial selection; the active switches and parameters determine the actual configuration.
:::

Configure PV generation on the dedicated [PV input](pv.qmd) page. Track conventional grid import, flexible grid import and self-consumption separately.

## Thermal building mass

Additional electric heating or cooling can use building mass as storage. The selected system and allowable setpoint deviation determine pre-conditioning. Set construction type and effective thermal mass on the [Building Physics](envelope.qmd#building-physics-inputs) worksheet.

## Hot-water storage {#hot-water-storage}

Flexible heating temporarily raises the temperature of existing storage. Check activation and the upper temperature limit. Storage volume, base supply and losses belong to the [hot-water configuration](hvac.qmd#domestic-hot-water).

## Electrical battery

Set activation, capacity, charge/discharge power, efficiencies and self-discharge together. Capacity in kWh and power in kW are distinct quantities. Charging source and discharge use determine the effect on imports and exports.

## Electric vehicles

Flexible charging and bidirectional use depend on parking times, charge power, capacity and minimum state of charge. Enter these on the [Mobility](mobility.qmd) worksheet.

## Dynamic assessment

![Method: imports, exports and time-dependent assessment of energy carriers. Training diagram supplied by the project owner.](../media/manual/dynamic-assessment.png){.manual-figure}

Hourly conversion factors assess when energy is used. Physical savings, shifting energy in time and improving an assessed balance should therefore be reported separately.

::: {.declaration-note}
**For a declaration:** use the prescribed flexibility settings, capacities and conversion factors. Alternative assumptions are possible in model variants but do not automatically establish declaration compliance.
:::

**Review results:** assess [annual indicators](results.qmd) together with [hourly flows and storage states](excel-dashboard.qmd).

Source: [Training, slides 9, 15 and 21](../downloads/schulung.pdf#page=15).
